name: Subang

queries.query: Subang Indonesia official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official Subang government site, Sitaru Subang planning map, and ATR/BPN BHUMI/ATLAS geospatial portals. The local map exposes planning/transport layers, not a bounded anonymous cadastral parcel feature response.

queries.query: Subang Indonesia peta bidang tanah kadaster GIS resmi
queries.result: Penelusuran sumber resmi menemukan Sitaru Subang dan portal data spasial ATR/BPN. Sitaru menyediakan peta pola ruang dan transportasi; tidak ditemukan respons anonim berisi identitas bidang tanah dan geometri poligon yang aman dalam pemeriksaan terbatas.

discoveryMethod: first-party English and Indonesian discovery plus bounded inspection of the official local viewer and ATR/BPN catalog/API routes
sourceReview: Sitaru Subang is an official local/regional planning map and procedure portal. Its current JavaScript/configuration references public GeoJSON endpoints for pola ruang and roads. Those responses contain planning/transport features and no qualified cadastral parcel identity. ATR/BPN BHUMI/ATLAS is the national land-spatial portal; the current public catalog route returned a 404 HTML page for the inspected API path, and no parcel feature response was obtained.

attemptsRecorded.outcome: Official Sitaru Subang map page loaded. It identifies the local map custodian/service context and displays pola ruang and transportasi layers; its disclaimer directs public-information clarification to PUPR Kabupaten Subang. No cadastral parcel layer was identified.
Public GeoJSON FeatureCollection returned (4,474,910 bytes) for spatial-planning polygons. It is not a cadastral parcel response; no geometry retained.
Public GeoJSON FeatureCollection returned (8,477,931 bytes) for district roads. It is not a cadastral parcel response; no geometry retained.

Official ATR/BPN BHUMI/ATLAS portal loaded. Page text describes land-spatial datasets and parcel-related map themes, but no anonymous Subang parcel feature response was exposed in the bounded inspection.
Current public API path from the viewer bundle returned a 404 HTML page; no credentials, login, CAPTCHA, or TLS bypass was attempted. This unavailable route was not treated as citywide absence.

Official BIG dashboard lists Peta Bidang Tanah as a national thematic-data category and identifies ATR/BPN cadastral directorate stewardship, but it did not expose a bounded Subang parcel feature response in this inspection.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: Sitaru inline JavaScript exposes Leaflet and public GeoJSON layer endpoints; ATR/BPN ATLAS exposes Next.js catalog JavaScript and an API route that returned 404.
schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: Sitaru responses are GeoJSON with longitude/latitude coordinate ordering; no cadastral layer CRS was observed. The planning/road layers were not retained.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: Not observed for a cadastral parcel; no parcel feature response obtained.
